title: Theme 5 reading and writing set: a clean-up campaign
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y11 lesson 37 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Theme 5 reading and writing set)
intro: Lesson 37. Read the text and answer the eight questions in English (Group A may answer in Arabic). Then write 100 words (Group B 90): كَيْفَ نَحْمِي البِيئَةَ؟

arabic.text:
فِي الرَّبِيعِ المَاضِي نَظَّمَ شَبَابُ المَسْجِدِ حَمْلَةً لِتَنْظِيفِ الحَدِيقَةِ العَامَّةِ وَالنَّهْرِ القَرِيبِ. شَارَكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ خَمْسِينَ مُتَطَوِّعًا، وَجَمَعُوا مِئَةَ كِيسٍ مِنَ النُّفَايَاتِ فِي يَوْمٍ وَاحِدٍ. كَانَ أَكْثَرُ النُّفَايَاتِ مِنَ البْلَاسْتِيكِ، مِثْلَ الزُّجَاجَاتِ وَالأَكْيَاسِ.
بَعْدَ الحَمْلَةِ وَضَعَتِ البَلَدِيَّةُ صَنَادِيقَ جَدِيدَةً لِإِعَادَةِ التَّدْوِيرِ. وَقَالَ إِمَامُ المَسْجِدِ إِنَّ الإِنْسَانَ مَسْؤُولٌ عَنِ الأَرْضِ، وَإِنَّ الإِسْرَافَ لَا يُحِبُّهُ اللّٰهُ.
فِي الصَّيْفِ القَادِمِ سَتَزْرَعُ الحَمْلَةُ مِئَتَيْ شَجَرَةٍ، وَيُرِيدُ المُنَظِّمُونَ أَنْ تُشَارِكَ المَدَارِسُ أَيْضًا.

questions.a: The young people of the mosque.

questions.q: What did they clean? Give two places.
questions.a: The public park and the nearby river.

questions.q: How much rubbish did they collect, and in how long?
questions.a: A hundred bags in one day.

questions.q: What was most of the rubbish?
questions.a: Plastic, such as bottles and bags.

questions.q: What did the council do after the campaign?
What did the imam say? Give two points.
questions.a: People are responsible for the earth; Allah does not love waste (israf).

questions.q: What are the plans for next summer?
questions.a: To plant two hundred trees; the organisers want schools to take part.

frame.label: Evidence: a campaign, or 'Do not cause corruption on the earth' (7:56)
